title: Absolute Dirac Neutrino Mass Spectrum, Topological Lepton Holonomies, and the Resolution of the DESI Cosmological Mass Bound in Unified Phase Dynamics
description:
We present a first-principles deductive derivation of the absolute neutrino mass spectrum, leptonic flavor mixing angles, and cosmological mass bounds without postulating ad-hoc beyond-the-Standard-Model (BSM) right-handed sterile neutrinos, high-scale Majorana seesaw mechanisms ( \sim 10^{14}$ GeV), or fine-tuned Yukawa couplings ( u \sim 10^{-12}$).

Reversing path orientation implements charge conjugation $\hat{\mathcal{C}}$. Consequently, lepton number is strictly conserved ($\Delta L \equiv 0$), the Weinberg dimension-5 operator vanishes identically ($\mathcal{O}_5 \equiv 0$), and neutrinos are proven to be strictly Dirac fermions.

The resulting squared mass splittings ($\Delta m_{21}^2 = 7.525 imes 10^{-5} ext{ eV}^2$ and $\Delta m_{31}^2 = 2.484 imes 10^{-3} ext{ eV}^2$) match global oscillation benchmarks (NuFIT 5.2) within .03\sigma$ and .12\sigma$.
